maria: please add reviewers. prefer present-tense and avoid 'we'll'.

alex: added @jamal and @olivia. preview: https://deploy-preview-452--docs.redwood.ai/

:docs-bot: Preview ready (build #1182).

jamal: lint fail in python snippet: uses client without init. suggest: 

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key='${REDWOOD_API_KEY}')
resp = client.text.generate(model='rw-v1', prompt='Translate into French: Hello')
print(resp.output[0].content)
```

maria: tone nit: avoid contractions, change prompt wording as above.

olivia: add note calling out example model and recommend pinning versions for prod.

sam: preview shows broken anchor to private-deployments.
